articles.title: Animoca-backed NUVA connects Figure's $19 billion of tokenized assets to Ethereum
articles.snippet: The protocol, led by veteran BNY executive Anthony Moro, aims to connect real-world assets with DeFi markets, starting with home equity lines of credit and Treasuries.

articles.title: Brickken and Magma partner to deliver Net Asset Value (NAV) oracle for tokenized real estate
articles.snippet: Built on Magma's Digital Twin Token (DTT) and Brickken's institutional tokenization infrastructure to close the data gap that has held tokenized real estate back.
